messages:
Zoe: Ran q8b-int3 overnight on multilingual promptset N. Seeing concentrated regressions for es/pt longtail prompts. Suspect dedupe/anchor mismatch after seedbank merge.
Ethan: Numbers? small deltas can hide systemic issues.
Zoe: Quick diffs vs q7: BLEU -1.6 (es), ROUGE-L -2.0 (pt), hallucination +0.07 on flagged set.
Priya: We recently merged AnchorBank-v2 which changed canonical anchor ids. That can shift golden alignment. Recommend: 1) fuzzy dedupe pass, 2) 100-sample golden relabel per locale, 3) run int4 vs int3 ablation.
Zoe: Agreed. I'll run fuzzy dedupe with threshold 0.78 and export sample ids.
Priya: Command: `python infra/dedupe.py --thresh 0.78 --locales es,pt --in promptset_N.json --out dedup_1770043211.json`
label-bot: Created LabelFlow task LR-599 "q8b-int3 multilingual relabel" 200 items (100 es,100 pt), priority: high.
Ethan: Also please run a short eval matrix: q8b-int3 (current kernel), q8b-int4 (older kernel), q7 (baseline). If q8b-int4 matches baseline, kernel path is suspect.
Zoe: Starting dedupe now. Will attach dedup_ file and sample lists here when ready.
ops-bot: Canary route configured: route requests tagged locale:es,pt and token_count>600 -> q7-canary. Enabled at 1770043300.
Priya: I'll standby to open relabel batch and set QA pass >=93%. Ping when dedup list is uploaded.
Zoe: Uploaded dedup list: https://internal/trace/dedup_1770043211.json. Kicking off eval matrix next.
Ethan: Good. If relabel closes gap, we can proceed with focused anchor reconciliation. If not, we'll escalate kernel rollback.
Zoe: Will post relabel summary and ablation results in this thread within 12h.
Priya: Thanks, everyone. Keeping relabel scope tight reduces labeler churn. :white_check_mark:
